title: Hoagland and Flynn hold joint conferences on the Mars ruins

tellings.quote: And in fact, Richard Hogland would did a series of conferences with David Flynn

plain: A researcher and filmmaker named Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that two writers worked together in the 1990s and early 2000s: Richard Hoagland, known for claiming there are ruins on Mars, and David Flynn. According to Alberino, the two put on a series of joint conferences in the United States about those supposed Martian ruins, a sign of how far the idea that someone once built on Mars had spread.
